description: Rewrite the Contact page (contact.html + contact.css + contact.js) onto the FEAT-001 foundation. Labelled fields (name, email, subject, message) each with a real
steps: Create c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/images/contact-hero.svg following the placeholder pattern (on-brand gradient + subtle pattern + 'Incredible India' watermark). No external references.

Rewrite c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/contact.html. Replace with the canonical head block (title 'Contact — Incredible India', unique meta description, fonts, favicon, styles.css + contact.css, inline `.js` script). Add the skip link, canonical header (aria-current="page" on Contact),
, canonical footer (fix the stray malformed footer), then . Match the header/footer/logo byte-identically to the other pages.
Add a short hero/intro heading (one h1 'Contact Us') + supporting line over the local contact-hero.svg with a dark overlay (reuse the hero pattern).

Build the contact form: `
`. Fields, each with a real

Add an honest 'not connected yet' notice near the form (e.g. `

This form is not connected to a backend yet — your message will not be sent. See the README to connect it.

`) visible by default. Add a status region (role="status"/aria-live) for submit outcomes.

Create c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/contact.js (vanilla, defer-safe). (a) Validation: on submit and on blur of each field, validate (name required min 2; email required + valid email regex; subject required min 3; message required min 10). Show the per-field error message, set aria-invalid and aria-describedby. On invalid submit, focus the first invalid field and prevent submission. (b) Submit handling: if all valid, check the form's data-endpoint — if it is the placeholder ('https://formspree.io/f/your-id') or empty, do NOT fake success: keep/reshow the 'not connected yet' notice and set the status region to a clear non-success message (e.g. 'Form not connected — no message was sent.'). Do NOT navigate or show a success message. If a real endpoint is configured (changed from the placeholder), attempt a fetch POST (JSON); only on a real successful response show a success message and reset the form; on failure show an error message. Never fake success.

Rewrite c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/contact.css for page-specific layout only (hero, form layout with labels above inputs, error styling, notice styling, info card). Reuse tokens from styles.css. Ensure the form is usable and no horizontal overflow 360px–1920px.
Remove all Font Awesome markup, the hotlinked Unsplash hero image, and the fake social links markup as needed (replace with the canonical footer; no phone numbers).
acceptance_criteria:
contact.html has the canonical head (unique title + meta description, fonts, favicon, styles.css + contact.css, inline .js script), skip link, canonical header (aria-current on Contact),
, canonical footer (the malformed stray is fixed), site.js + contact.js deferred — matching the other pages.
The form has data-endpoint="https://formspree.io/f/your-id", real <label for> for each of name/email/subject/message, per-field error elements, aria-invalid toggling, and aria-describedby wiring.
Validation runs on submit and on blur; invalid submit is prevented and the first invalid field is focused.
With the default placeholder endpoint, submitting a valid form does NOT show a success message — it shows/keeps the 'not connected yet' notice and a non-success status message.
An honest 'not connected yet' notice is visible near the form by default.
No hotlinked images; no phone numbers; the contact hero is local SVG.
verification: `python -m http.server 8000`; open http://localhost:8000/contact.html — submit empty → required errors appear and submission is blocked; blur a field → its error updates; fill valid data and submit → the 'not connected yet' notice / a non-success status shows (NO success message).
Inspect the <form> element → data-endpoint is present and equals the placeholder Formspree URL.
No 404s for contact.css, contact.js, or images/contact-hero.svg; no external image URLs remain.
Resize 360px–1920px — no horizontal overflow; the footer is well-formed (no stray ).
